fields.name: Entity
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x1D78060(storage, entity) creates the component on that entity and stores the same handle here; bg3.exe+0x1D59100 later copies it to ecl::CombatTimelineDataComponent+0x110. bg3.exe+0x1D55010 passes the freshly created timeline entity. Live: a live entity handle.

fields.name: IsSystemic
fields.evidence: Created as 0 (16-bit store at +8), then set by bg3.exe+0x1D55010 from the combat timeline creation request (byte 8 of its 16-byte tail). In the same function a non-zero value sets Timeline+0x48A (IsSystemicCombatTimeline by Timeline.h field order) and timeline type 2; zero selects the authored (+0x48B, type 3) or the +0x48C (type 10) variant. bg3.exe+0x1D59100 copies it to CombatTimelineDataComponent+0xFC and builds the systemic camera data only when it is 0. Live: 1.

fields.name: field_9
fields.evidence: Byte 9 of the same request; when IsSystemic is 0 it chooses between Timeline+0x48B (0, type 3) and Timeline+0x48C (non-zero, type 10 - IsMainMenuTimeline by Timeline.h order, which looks wrong for a combat timeline, hence no name). Copied to CombatTimelineDataComponent+0xFD. Live: 0.

open_questions: Whether Entity is always the component's own entity (it is in the only creation site) or can point at another timeline entity.
Name of the flag at +9 (timeline type 10).
